current_rows.name: chem.ph

declaration.source: cytosolic pH ~7.2. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

detail.law: pH sets the protonation of every rate that has an acid-base step (free Mg2+ speciating the nucleotide pool was the other half of this entry and is IMPLEMENTED — SPECIATION_ROWS)
detail.blocker: a pH-dependent rate needs a rate row measured AGAINST pH, and this corpus contains none: of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH at all (pinned by tests/product/cell/test_bounded_omissions.py). Verified again on 2026-09-21 by the bundle-kind/speciation lane over spec.example.toml and the codex/bio-wiring-20260915 source branch: no pH-dependent rate law exists on either. Writing one would be inventing a law, which the lane brief forbids, so this row STOPS here. The screening half of the old entry is also still unbuildable: no relation kind carries a charge, and giving one a charge is a resolution decision (see the bound), not a missing line of code
detail.bound: E' P2 / P3, two numbers. (i) SCREENING: at chem.ionic_strength 150 mM the Debye length is 0.8 nm — 1/56 of the SHORTEST interaction reach in the spec (erm.reach 45 nm) and 1/62 of resolution.spacing, so a screened term is exp(-56) = 3.7e-25 of an unscreened one at the closest distance this model resolves. (ii) SPECIATION, kept as the PREDICTION the device run is compared with now that the law is BUILT: at chem.mg_free 500 uM and chem.mgatp_kd 100 uM (a spec row since 2026-09-21; it was literature-only when this bound was written), [MgATP] is 0.8333 x chem.atp_conc, so the ATP-binding edge runs at 2500 /s instead of 3000 /s and the crossbridge cycle time 0.486 s (sum of 1/k_adp_release, 1/k_stroke, 1/k_pi_release, 1/k_hydrolysis, 1/(k_atp_bind x atp_conc)) lengthens by 0.014 %; even at a 10x weaker Kd of 1000 uM it is 0.137 %
detail.verdict: SMALL FOR THIS ENGINE — the screened term is below floating-point at the model's own resolution, and Mg-ATP speciation (now BUILT) moves the crossbridge cycle by 0.014 % (0.14 % at a 10x weaker Kd), far inside the spread the rate rows already declare. The honesty this number does NOT buy: chem.mg_free and chem.ph are often called "the conditions the rates were measured at", and reading the sources says otherwise — of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH, and the 3 that state Mg (Pollard 1986) state 1 mM TOTAL MgCl2 at 22 C in 50 mM KCl (ionic strength ~53 mM), not 0.5 mM FREE Mg at 150 mM. So the transfer error in those rows is UNBOUNDED by anything in this file; what is bounded here is only this engine's sensitivity. Closing that needs the sources read and their conditions written into the rows (a KB item, INVENTORY E' P3)

conditional_relations.statement: Actual hydrolysis Gibbs energy depends on a defined reaction, activities/conditional species and standard state at a specified chemical context. Current declarations do not establish one matched source context.
conditional_relations.conditional_expression: For a fixed transformed biochemical convention: deltaG = deltaG0_prime + R*T*ln(Q_prime). A concentration quotient needs dimensionless normalization and conditional constants appropriate to the chosen ion conditions.
assumptions: reaction ATP + water -> ADP + inorganic phosphate
consistent species sums or specified chemical species, not a mixture of conventions
fixed or accounted pH, free Mg, ionic strength and temperature

conditional_relations.statement: Frozen cycle_affinity assumes declared positive dG is the released magnitude at the prepared pool, then scales exp(dG/kT) by the live/prepared inverse-reaction-quotient ratio.
assumptions: same concentration units in live and prepared quotients so their dimensions cancel
conditional_relations.unresolved: No matched source shows the generic dG belongs to the prepared concentrations. No separate missing-1M arithmetic defect is asserted for this quotient ratio.
conditional_relations.frozen_temperature_selection: kBT is supplied from bonds.kbt using cell.temperature (bonds.py:70–72); this differs from the electrolyte screening temperature-selection path. Both declared temperatures are 310 K in the frozen atlas.

conditional_relations.statement: Frozen code uses Mg/(Kd+Mg) to scale an ATP-binding coefficient under buffered free Mg and a single-site convention.
assumptions: ATP_pool is the available aqueous pool excluding molecule-bound nucleotide, summed across the two represented forms
free Mg is buffered, not total Mg
Kd is conditional on the intended pH/T/medium; equilibrium is fast enough for this comparison
conditional_relations.unresolved: Full ion/proton competition, mass balance and sensor-specific ATP semantics are not supplied by the declared point values. No alternate equilibrium model is proposed.

conditional_relations.statement: Debye length is a conditional calculation, not a second independent observation once ionic strength, permittivity and solution temperature are fixed.
assumptions: concentration-based I in SI mol/m^3; numerically 1 mM = 1 mol/m^3
uniform continuum permittivity and linearized electrolyte-screening approximation
conditional_relations.frozen_temperature_selection: first present positive row in [osmotic.reference_temperature, cell.temperature]; both declared 310 K in the frozen atlas
does_not_establish: single symmetric monovalent salt as necessary chemical composition

conditional_relations.statement: MgG fluorescence -> calibrated free Mg -> computed ATP efflux is one measurement chain. Imported Kd and derived ATP must not be counted as additional independent measurements.
assumptions: original assay volume and time-zero composition retained

limitations: No current chemical row is promoted to sourced or measurement status. The existing SOURCED temperature tag is preserved, not independently certified.
No jointly observed MCF7 ATP/ADP/Pi/free Mg/pH/ionic-strength/deltaG preparation was established.
No current numerical ADP, Pi, free Mg or cellular ionic strength source was located; absence of support is not a falsification.
